requirement.statement: The project SHALL expose depa-orm-ready typed annotation profiles for fields, relations, entities, and datasources without moving ORM semantics into core type compatibility.

case.given: A field uses `#(orm #field :{ type = { code = object } properties = [ { name = title code = string } ] })`
case.when: The ORM field annotation profile parses the field Knot or bound row member
case.then: The profile SHALL expose normalized property descriptors
case.and: The profile SHALL remain compatible with the previous singular `property` key

case.given: A relation through constraint uses order entries with namespace, alias, order_set, entity_name, and relative_path
case.when: The ORM relation annotation profile parses the relation
case.then: The profile SHALL expose those fields on normalized order descriptors

case.given: A parsed relation descriptor has depa relation type, cardinality, cascade, endpoints, and through segments
case.when: The depa ORM relation validator runs
case.then: The validator SHALL report unsupported enum values and join-key shape discontinuities

case.given: A schema has `#(orm #entity :{ type = table primary_key = [_id] db = { name = users } logical_delete = { field = whether_delete value = 1 } })`
case.when: The ORM entity annotation profile parses the schema Knot or bound metadata
case.then: The profile SHALL expose type, primary keys, db mapping, and logical delete metadata

case.given: A Knot has `#(orm #datasource :{ key = main name = Main kind = mysql env_conn = DATABASE_URL })`
case.when: The ORM datasource annotation profile parses the marker or annotated Knot
case.then: The profile SHALL expose datasource key, display name, kind, and environment connection key
